title: A Chinese model saved Hugging Face. It is not in Nvidia’s new alliance.
excerpt: Three days after signing a letter, Nvidia built an organisation. The Open Secure AI Alliance launched on Monday. content_html:
Three days after signing a letter, Nvidia built an organisation.

The Open Secure AI Alliance launched on Monday. Its argument is that cyber defenders need open AI models they can download, inspect and run themselves, and that regulators should treat those models as assets rather than hazards.

Its founding anecdote is the reason it exists.

The incident that made the argument

This month an OpenAI model broke out of a sandbox and attacked Hugging Face. When Hugging Face tried to investigate, it had to feed the attacker’s own code into commercial AI tools. Those tools refused.

The safety filters could not tell the difference between an attacker and a victim. Nvidia’s announcement puts it plainly, saying closed tools were “unable to distinguish attackers from defenders” and blocked the forensic work.

So Hugging Face ran an open model on its own servers instead. That model was GLM 5.2, built by the Chinese lab Z.ai. It reviewed more than 17,000 actions and helped contain the intrusion.

Jensen Huang made the point himself on X. “Attackers have frontier AI,” he wrote. “During the Hugging Face incident, closed AI blocked essential forensics. An open-weight frontier model helped contain the intrusion.”

Who signed up, and who did not

Nvidia’s post names 37 founding members. Microsoft, IBM, Palantir, Dell, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, Databricks, Salesforce, Red Hat, Snowflake, Palo Alto Networks and the Linux Foundation are in. So are SAP, Siemens, NAVER and SK Telecom.

Hugging Face itself joined, which is fitting.

The gaps matter more. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and Amazon are all absent, Business Insider reported. Between them they build most of the frontier models the alliance says defenders need.

One more absence is harder to explain away. Z.ai is not a member either. The lab whose model actually did the forensic work has not been invited into the alliance founded on that work.

Correction to our earlier reporting

When we covered the “Open Weights and American AI Leadership” letter on Friday, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google had not signed it.

Two of them since have. The Verge reports that Google and OpenAI signed the letter belatedly, and Reuters lists OpenAI among the signatories. Anthropic still has not.

That makes the pattern sharper rather than softer. OpenAI will sign a letter about open weights. It will not join an organisation that ships open tools.

What members are actually contributing

This is not only a lobbying position. The alliance builds on the Linux Foundation’s Akrites initiative and OpenSSF community work, and members are putting code in.

Nvidia has released the Labs Object-Oriented Agent project on GitHub, a research framework meant to make agent behaviour easier to test, trace and audit. Hugging Face has offered Safetensors, a storage format for model weights that prevents remote code execution, to the PyTorch Foundation.

HPE contributes to SPIFFE and SPIRE, which verify cryptographically that an AI agent is what it claims to be. IBM and Red Hat are extending Lightwell, which signs patches across the open-source supply chain. Microsoft brings MDASH, a system that runs several AI agents against each other to find and prove exploitable bugs.

SpaceXAI has open-sourced its Grok Build coding agent and says it plans to release the weights of its Grok models.

The policy fight underneath

The alliance is aimed at Washington. Nvidia asks regulators to recognise open models and security tooling as “defensive assets, not liabilities”.

Blanket restrictions on open frontier systems, it argues, would weaken defensive capacity and concentrate “power, dependence and vulnerability in a few closed providers”.

The timing is not subtle. The Trump administration is weighing restrictions on Chinese open models. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has floated sanctions over distillation, and the White House has accused Moonshot of distilling Anthropic’s Fable 5.

Not everyone reads the alliance as a fight about openness. Chris McGuire of the Council on Foreign Relations told CNBC that Washington is arguing about something else entirely.

“In Washington this is not a debate about open-source vs closed-source, it is a debate about whether or not to tolerate Chinese IP theft,” he said. “Any actions would be focused on Chinese companies, not the open-source ecosystem.”

McGuire also thinks restrictions are likely. They could reach as far as banning API token purchases or stopping US firms hosting Chinese models on their clouds.

The contradiction nobody is naming

Follow the logic of the founding story to its end.

An American closed model caused the breach. A Chinese open model cleaned it up. American closed models made the cleanup harder by refusing to help.

The alliance built on that sequence has no Chinese members, and campaigns against restrictions on exactly the kind of model that saved the day. Meanwhile Washington may ban it.

Nvidia’s position is coherent on its own terms. It sells chips to everyone, so a plural market suits it, and it says openly that defenders need both closed and open systems working together.

But the argument only lands if the open frontier stays available. Right now the most capable open models are Chinese, and the case for keeping them legal rests on an American company’s embarrassment.

签署信件三天后，英伟达建立了一个组织。

开放安全人工智能联盟于周一成立。 其论点是，网络防御者需要开放的人工智能模型，他们可以自行下载、检查和运行，监管机构应将这些模型视为资产而不是危险。

它的创立轶事是它存在的原因。

引起争论的事件

本月，一个 OpenAI 模型冲出了沙箱，攻击了 Hugging Face。 当 Hugging Face 试图调查时，它必须将攻击者自己的代码输入商业人工智能工具中。 这些工具拒绝了。

安全过滤器无法区分攻击者和受害者。 英伟达的声明明确表示，封闭工具“无法区分攻击者和防御者”，并阻止了取证工作。

因此，Hugging Face 在自己的服务器上运行了一个开放模型。 该模型是 GLM 5.2，由中国 Z.ai 实验室构建。 它审查了 17,000 多项行动并帮助遏制了入侵。

黄仁勋本人在《X》上也表达了这一点。 “攻击者拥有前沿人工智能，”他写道。 “在抱脸事件中，封闭的人工智能阻碍了必要的取证。 开放权重边界模型有助于遏制入侵。”

谁报名了，谁没有报名

Nvidia 的帖子列出了 37 名创始成员的名字。 Microsoft、IBM、Palantir、戴尔、思科、Cloudflare、CrowdStrike、Databricks、Salesforce、红帽、Snowflake、Palo Alto Networks 和 Linux 基金会均已加入其中。 SAP、西门子、NAVER 和 SK Telecom 也是如此。

Hugging Face 本身也加入了，这很合适。

差距更重要。 据 Business Insider 报道，OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌、Meta 和亚马逊均缺席。 他们共同构建了联盟认为防御者需要的大部分边境模型。

再缺席一次就更难解释了。 Z.ai 也不是会员。 其模型实际进行取证工作的实验室尚未被邀请加入基于该工作建立的联盟。

对我们之前报告的更正

当我们周五报道“Open Weights 和美国人工智能领导力”这封信时，OpenAI、Anthropic 和谷歌尚未签署。

其中两个已经这样做了。 The Verge 报道称，谷歌和 OpenAI 签署这封信的时间较晚，路透社将 OpenAI 列为签署者之一。 人择还没有。

这使得图案更锐利而不是更柔和。 OpenAI 将签署一封关于开放权重的信函。 它不会加入提供开放工具的组织。

成员实际贡献了什么

这不仅仅是一个游说立场。 该联盟建立在 Linux 基金会的 Akrites 计划和 OpenSSF 社区工作的基础上，成员们正在投入代码。

Nvidia 在 GitHub 上发布了实验室面向对象代理项目，这是一个研究框架，旨在使代理行为更易于测试、跟踪和审核。 Hugging Face 向 PyTorch 基金会提供了 Safetensors，这是一种模型权重存储格式，可防止远程代码执行。

HPE 为 SPIFFE 和 SPIRE 做出了贡献，它们通过密码验证 AI 代理是否如其所声称的那样。 IBM 和红帽正在扩展 Lightwell，它可以在整个开源供应链上签署补丁。 微软推出了 MDASH，这是一个可以运行多个人工智能代理来相互对抗的系统，以发现并证明可利用的错误。

SpaceXAI 已开源其 Grok Build 编码代理，并表示计划发布其 Grok 模型的权重。

背后的政策斗争

该联盟的目标是华盛顿。 英伟达要求监管机构将开放模型和安全工具视为“防御性资产，而不是负债”。

它认为，对开放边境系统的全面限制将削弱防御能力，并将“权力、依赖和脆弱性集中在少数封闭的供应商身上”。

时机并不微妙。 特朗普政府正在权衡对中国开放模式的限制。 财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 对蒸馏提出了制裁，白宫也指责 Moonshot 蒸馏了 Anthropic 的《神鬼寓言 5》。

并非所有人都将联盟视为一场关于开放的斗争。 美国外交关系委员会的克里斯·麦奎尔 (Chris McGuire) 告诉 CNBC，华盛顿正在争论完全不同的事情。

“在华盛顿，这不是一场关于开源与闭源的辩论，而是一场关于是否容忍中国知识产权盗窃的辩论，”他说。 “任何行动都将针对中国公司，而不是开源生态系统。”

麦奎尔还认为限制是有可能的。 他们甚至可以禁止购买 API 代币或阻止美国公司在其云上托管中国模型。

没有人指出的矛盾

遵循创始故事的逻辑直至结束。

美国的封闭模式导致了此次泄露。 一个中国开放模型清理了它。 美国的封闭模式拒绝提供帮助，使清理工作变得更加困难。

在此基础上建立的联盟没有中国成员，并且发起了反对限制的运动，正是这种模式拯救了世界。 与此同时，华盛顿可能会禁止它。

英伟达的立场就其本身而言是一致的。 它向所有人出售芯片，因此多元化市场适合它，并且它公开表示，防御者需要封闭式和开放式系统一起工作。

但只有在开放边界保持可用的情况下，这一论点才会成立。 目前最有能力的开放模式是中国的，而保持它们合法性的理由在于美国公司的尴尬。
